no_adcom_quote.quote: This application was not referred to an FDA advisory committee because the safety profile, although it includes serious risks, is not clearly worse than other drugs to treat MS and daclizumab represents a presumably novel mechanism of action.

summary: No FDA advisory committee meeting was convened for the Zinbryta (daclizumab) BLA. The Summary Review states the application was not referred to an advisory committee because the safety profile, though including serious risks, was not clearly worse than other MS drugs and the drug has a novel mechanism; the Cross-Discipline Team Leader review likewise states there were no plans for an advisory committee meeting. Because no committee met, there are no committee-driven linkages to approval changes (the boxed warning, REMS, and second-line indication restriction were driven by the internal review team and REMS Oversight Committee, not an AdComm).
